Name: --diffusion-model → sd_ctx_params_t.diffusion_model_path
Comment: Path to the Wan I2V transformer (e.g. wan2.1_i2v_14B_480p_fp16.safetensors or wan2.1_fun_i2v_1.3B_fp16.safetensors). MUST be an I2V build, not T2V.

Name: --t5xxl → sd_ctx_params_t.t5xxl_path
Comment: Path to the UMT5-XXL text encoder used by Wan (e.g. umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors).

Name: --vae → sd_ctx_params_t.vae_path
Comment: Path to the Wan VAE (e.g. wan_2.1_vae.safetensors).

Name: --high-noise-diffusion-model → sd_ctx_params_t.high_noise_diffusion_model_path
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only — second expert weights. Leave empty for Wan 2.1 / Wan-Fun.

Name: -t / --threads → sd_ctx_params_t.n_threads
Comment: CPU thread count for non-GPU work. -1 = auto.

Name: --prediction → sd_ctx_params_t.prediction
Comment: Velocity/noise prediction type. Auto-detected as FLOW_PRED for Wan; only set explicitly to override.

Name: --offload-to-cpu → sd_ctx_params_t.offload_params_to_cpu
Comment: Stream weights from CPU during inference. Strongly recommended on <=24 GB VRAM for Wan 14B I2V.

Name: --diffusion-fa → sd_ctx_params_t.diffusion_flash_attn
Comment: Enable flash-attention for the diffusion transformer. Big speedup on Wan I2V; recommended ON.

Name: --type → sd_ctx_params_t.wtype
Comment: Quantization weight type override. Leave default (SD_TYPE_COUNT) to use whatever the file declares.

Name: --prompt → sd_vid_gen_params_t.prompt
Comment: Text prompt describing the desired motion / scene continuation from the init image.

Name: --negative-prompt → sd_vid_gen_params_t.negative_prompt
Comment: Negative prompt. Useful for I2V to suppress motion artefacts (e.g. ""blurry

Name: --width → sd_vid_gen_params_t.width
Comment: Output width. Wan-Fun 1.3B / I2V 480p: 832. I2V 720p: 1280.

Name: --height → sd_vid_gen_params_t.height
Comment: Output height. Wan-Fun 1.3B / I2V 480p: 480. I2V 720p: 720.

Name: --video-frames → sd_vid_gen_params_t.video_frames
Comment: Total frames. Must satisfy (4*k + 1). Sweet spot: 81 (~5s @ 16fps).

Name: --seed → sd_vid_gen_params_t.seed
Comment: Random seed. -1 = random.

Name: --strength → sd_vid_gen_params_t.strength
Comment: I2V denoising strength on init_image, [0, 1]. 1.0 = full re-noise. 0.6-0.85 preserves more of the seed frame. New surface for the img2vid path.

Name: --init-image → sd_vid_gen_params_t.init_image
Comment: REQUIRED for img2vid. Decoded seed frame (RGB).

Name: --end-image → sd_vid_gen_params_t.end_image
Comment: Unused for img2vid (flf2vid only). Leave zeroed.

Name: --control-frames → sd_vid_gen_params_t.control_frames
Comment: Optional VACE control frames. Pair with control_frames_size.

Name: (N/A) → sd_vid_gen_params_t.control_frames_size
Comment: Number of entries in control_frames. 0 disables VACE.

Name: --vace-strength → sd_vid_gen_params_t.vace_strength
Comment: VACE control strength [0, 1]. Default 1.0 when control_frames provided.

Name: --moe-boundary → sd_vid_gen_params_t.moe_boundary
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only. Timestep boundary for high-noise expert switchover. Default 0.875.

Name: --sampling-method → sd_sample_params_t.sample_method
Comment: Sampler. Wan I2V recommended: EULER_SAMPLE_METHOD (CLI: euler).

Name: --scheduler → sd_sample_params_t.scheduler
Comment: Sigma schedule. "simple" works for Wan I2V; only override if you know why.

Name: --steps → sd_sample_params_t.sample_steps
Comment: Denoising steps. Wan I2V sweet spot: 30-50. More = sharper but linear time cost.

Name: --flow-shift → sd_sample_params_t.flow_shift
Comment: CRITICAL for Wan I2V: 480p = 3.0, 720p = 5.0, Wan-Fun 1.3B = 3.0. Different from T2V. Wrong value -> dim/dark output.

Name: --cfg-scale → sd_sample_params_t.guidance.txt_cfg
Comment: Classifier-free-guidance scale on the text prompt. Wan I2V sweet spot: 5.0-6.5.

Name: --img-cfg → sd_sample_params_t.guidance.img_cfg
Comment: CFG on the image conditioning. ACTIVE for img2vid. Default 1.0-1.5; raise to push harder toward the seed frame.

Name: sd_sample_params_t (high_noise_sample_params)
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only. Mirrors the main sampler block; unset fields fall back to the low-noise values.

Name: --high-noise-sampling-method → high_noise_sample_params.sample_method
Comment: Sampler used during the high-noise phase.

Name: --high-noise-scheduler → high_noise_sample_params.scheduler
Comment: Scheduler for high-noise phase.

Name: --high-noise-steps → high_noise_sample_params.sample_steps
Comment: Step count for high-noise phase. 0 = mirror sample_steps.

Name: --high-noise-flow-shift → high_noise_sample_params.flow_shift
Comment: flow_shift for high-noise phase. 0 = mirror low-noise flow_shift.

Name: --high-noise-cfg-scale → high_noise_sample_params.guidance.txt_cfg
Comment: Text CFG for the high-noise phase. 0 = mirror low-noise txt_cfg.

Name: sd_vae_tiling_params_t (on sd_vid_gen_params_t.vae_tiling_params)
Comment: Recommended ON for Wan VAE at I2V resolutions.

Name: --vae-tiling → vae_tiling_params.enabled
Comment: Strongly recommended ON. Wan VAE blows VRAM at 832x480+ otherwise.

Name: --vae-tile-size-x → vae_tiling_params.tile_size_x
Comment: VAE tile width. Sensible default 256.

Name: --vae-tile-size-y → vae_tiling_params.tile_size_y
Comment: VAE tile height. Sensible default 256.

Name: --vae-tile-overlap → vae_tiling_params.target_overlap
Comment: Overlap fraction between tiles. Default 0.5.

Name: --cache-mode → cache.mode
Comment: Diffusion-step cache strategy (none / per-step / etc.).

Name: --cache-threshold → cache.reuse_threshold
Comment: Reuse threshold for the cache.

Name: --fps → SDGenerationParams.fps
Comment: Encoder-side fps only — passed to the MJPG-AVI muxer at write time, never to the model. The model itself is fps-agnostic.

Name: -o / --output → SDCliParams.output_path
Comment: Output path. The vid_gen muxer always appends .avi regardless of extension.

Name: -M / --mode → SDCliParams.mode
Comment: Picks the call target: VID_GEN → generate_video() with img2vid branch (init_image populated, end_image empty).
